body: The engine is proven end to end on a real app (docsi/SPIKE2_RESULTS.md): simultaneous logins, localStorage isolation keyed by session, save/restore/duplicate, 3 of 3 runs. What is missing is a product: popup to create/name/pick a session, session list with search, the unmissable in-page badge plus toolbar badge, and per-origin coverage reporting. Port spike/ext2 into the house stack (pnpm + Vite + React 19 + Tailwind v4 + Base UI + zustand, vitest).
title: Build the real extension: UI, session list, badge
